raw_payload.what_happens: Lakhā reaches into his coat and pulls out his loyal dog, a scruffy yet alert hound. He places the dog at the Sheth's feet, promising to repay the loan and bring the dog back safely. The Sheth smiles faintly, accepting the canine as collateral, while the dog wags its tail, unaware of the stakes.
raw_payload.narration: Lakhā slips his coat, revealing a scruffy, alert hound. He gently places the dog at the Sheth's feet, pledging to repay the loan and return the faithful companion, while the dog wags blissfully.
